evidence: The training data contains 6,482 authors for 7,538 videos, indicating users likely encounter the same creators repeatedly. Recommendation systems benefit strongly from explicit user-creator preference signals that might not be fully captured by independent user and video embeddings.
expected_effect: Introducing a direct user-author interaction term will enable the model to explicitly learn and memorize user-specific preferences for individual content creators, boosting personalized ranking accuracy.
hypothesis: Adding the user_author_affinity operator during the features stage will capture persistent individual user preferences for specific authors, leading to a more accurate personalized ranking and an improved validation GAUC and nDCG.
